acceptance.given: A subprocess capability is configured for execution with shell evaluation requested.

oracle.expected: The capability rejects the request with a failure result explicitly indicating shell evaluation is disallowed.
forbidden: The subprocess operation succeeds or proceeds using shell evaluation.
The failure result is absent or reports success.
oracle.observable: The subprocess invocation result and structured error/status show shell evaluation was denied.

acceptance.then: The shell-evaluation attempt fails at the subprocess execution boundary.
acceptance.when: The subprocess capability processes the shell-evaluation request.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Invoke the subprocess capability with shell evaluation enabled and assert that execution fails with shell evaluation denied.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce shell=false at the subprocess execution boundary and reject shell-evaluation requests deterministically.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; rollback restores prior subprocess boundary behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Shell-evaluation request transitions to an explicit rejected failure result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A targeted test demonstrates shell-evaluation requests fail and no subprocess proceeds with shell evaluation.

acceptance.given: The validator is executing a local filesystem inspection against a package and its declared roots.

oracle.expected: All filesystem inspection remains within the validator's local inspection boundary; escaping paths are rejected and an outside sentinel is neither read nor modified.
forbidden: The validator reads or modifies a path outside its local boundary.
The validator proceeds without enforcing containment or traversal/symlink handling.
oracle.observable: Validator diagnostics and filesystem state show only in-boundary paths were inspected, while an out-of-boundary sentinel remains unchanged.

acceptance.then: The validator completes with inspection activity constrained to its local filesystem boundary.
acceptance.when: The validator performs filesystem checks and evaluates containment, traversal, and symlink rules.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run boundary fixtures containing an escaping path or outside-package symlink and assert validation fails without reading or modifying the outside sentinel.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Constrain validator filesystem inspection to declared local roots and reject escaping paths or symlink traversal outside the package.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validator behavior only; rollback restores prior inspection behavior without data migration.

slice_hint.state_transition: Filesystem inspection transitions to containment-enforced local checks with rejection of boundary escapes.
